FAQ – Frequently Asked Question:

Can I place an order if I live outside the U.S.A.?

We can ship to UK, but I can’t do it for the flat $6 rate we offer in USA. You can call my studio with what you want and Rob, “the best guy shipping guy in the history of forever” who usually answers the phone, can do the research and give you a quote on your order. (so far, the coast has been around $20-30 per order) Also if you have any knowledge or connections, you want us to send it through, we are all ears. International shipping is a mystery to many. We only charge our international orders the exact charge of the carrier you ultimately decide on from the choice Rob will give you.

   Our past experience is that if you group your orders together with family and friends the shipping price per item does even it out a bit and make it more cost effective. (Example: One item costs a significant amount. They second item added to package not much more, to where the 4-5 items seem to add little to no additional fees.) So, keep that in mind. Studio Number: 407-775-9984 Studio Email: Sales@SuzyToronto.com

   P.S. We will ship out of the US and provide tracking and check on the order anytime you would like but we are not responsible for the package being delayed or not being delivered. We will bend over backwards to send it any way that you feel would be best, but please keep in mind, we have no control over the postal system and how they operate. (wouldn’t that be great if we could.)

If you are still interested in placing an order, feel free to email us at Sales@SuzyToronto.com with everything you would like to order and your complete emailing address so that we can run the numbers and reply with a few shipping options for you to choose form.

When can I order next years Calendars and Planner and when will I get them?

All Calendars and Planners will start taking Pre-Orders around April of each year an are scheduled to ship out by the end of August of that same year. The Large Calendars and Granddaughter Calendars tend to come in first and then the Small Calendars followed by the Planner. (Sometimes the Planner can run into September to ship) All Pre-orders are at a discounted price and will typically offer the glitter and gems upgrades for free. Once the Calendars and Planner are available for purchase then the prices will go up. So if you are looking for discounted prices, pre-ordering is the best way to get that deal.

I want a specific Suzy design but I don’t see it on the item I am looking to purchase?

No worries, just contact Robert are Admin@SuzyToronto.com with the design and the item you would like it to be on and he will either find it or put it into production for you to be able to order. Even if you are looking for an item that is not available yet he can get the wheels turning to see if that is something that Suzy’s Studio can get in to production for you. We ALWAYS appreciate the feedback (both good and bad)

My mug broke and I need to get a new one. Where can I go to get a replacement?

Suzy has designed MANY coffee mugs over the decades and it would be hard to tell you where to get that exact mug unless we had a photo to reference it from. The current mug that is still available (On Amazon, through our wholesale license) will have a black handle and a black inside. Any other mug is more than likely discontinued and not available through normal avenues. You might be able to find a replacement for those on E-Bay or Etsy but we do caution you about ordering from those site for we do not represent them in any way shape or form. “Buyer Beware” as they like to say.

 

If you have any other questions that have not been addressed her please email Robert at Admin@SuzyToronto.com or call at 407-775-9984 with your question(s) and he will be happy to help you in any way that he can. We do not have any robots or AI here so you are mostly likely to get a human when you call or email us.

Kukana Kamelani

My name is Kukanakamelani… Kukana for short. I am an artist and writer. It’s not something I simply do… it’s who and what I am. My world is filled with color and passion and a whole lot of paint. When I’m not creating, I’m dancing the hula, creating beautiful Hawaiian feather work or hanging out with my girlfriends on the beach. Life is good and I wouldn’t have it any other way. Welcome to my world.

Growing up in the islands of Hawai’i, I was forever surrounded by spectacular beauty. As a third-generation professional artist it was only natural to want to capture that beauty in art. Since those early days of exploring my artistic ability, my travels around the world added new visions to the genre I paint. Yet, I like to think there is still a little bit of the islands in everything I do. Since I have always loved writing and expressing heartfelt emotions, pairing up my two passions was effortless and a perfect fit.

Today, I live in New Smyrna Beach Florida, just inches away from the surf of the Atlantic Ocean. My fine art can be seen in hotels and restaurants throughout Florida and now, this new direction of keepsakes filled with both passion and purpose are here for you to discover.  Welcome to my world.

Return Policy

RETURN POLICY

EFFECTIVE DATE: September 8th, 2023

Return Policy:

You are a valued customer, and we want your shopping experience with us to be hassle-free. We offer a 30-day return policy for items that are eligible for return.

Eligible Returns:

  1. Unopened Items

Unopened items can be returned within 30 days unless specifically stated on the product details page.

  1. Damaged Items

Any item damaged in transit can be exchanged for a replacement of the same item if you send us the request within 30 days of receiving your order. If the item is no longer available, we will issue a refund.

We may request that you e-mail a picture of your damaged item.

Ineligible Returns

  1. Opened Items
    • Opened items are not eligible for returns. this includes:
    • Items that have been opened or removed from the packaging.
    • Items that have visible indications that the package has been opened. 
  1. If you received an item that was defective, missing parts, or was purchased from another store, please contact our Consumer Care team at CustomerService@SuzyToronto.com

How to Return an Item

Please contact us at CustomerService@SuzyToronto.com within 30 days of delivery to obtain a Return Merchandise Authorization number and instructions. You will be responsible for return shipping costs unless the return is due to our error or transit damage. Please note that we cannot accept any returns without a Return Merchandise Authorization. All unauthorized returns will be returned to the sender.

How to Prepare Your Item for Return Shipping

  • Please pack the items securely in a box.
  • You can use the box the items arrived in or another box. Please ensure all old shipping labels and barcodes have been removed.
  • Send your Return to us using an insured or traceable shipper that is most convenient for you.
  • Please include a copy of this email in your box.

Once you have dropped off your return with the carrier, please reply to us and provide the return tracking number, as well as the name of the carrier you’ve selected. This will allow us to better monitor the progress of your return. Please allow up to two billing cycles for any eligible refund to appear on your statement.

Processing Your Return or Replacement

Please allow 21 days to process your return. You will receive an email notification once your return has been received and processed. If we are unable to send a replacement for the exact item purchased, we will issue a refund to the form of payment used to place the order. Please allow up to two billing cycles for any refund to appear on your statement.

What if a product I ordered has missing parts?

Oh no! Please contact Suzy Toronto’s Consumer Care: CustomerService@SuzyToronto.com We are available via email and telephone, and very happy to help! 

Returns on Items Purchased with Discount or Promotional Code

If you return an order that was placed with a promotional code, discount, or offer, you’ll be refunded for the amount you paid after the discount was applied.

Refused and Undeliverable Shipments

A refused shipment will be treated as a return and any return costs will be deducted from the refund.

If a shipment is returned to us as undeliverable due to an error on your part (such as incorrect address or not home), we will contact you to reship the package.

Returns of Crowdfunded Products

CANCELLATION AND REFUNDS/RETURNS

Cancelling Your Order
If you need to cancel your order, you must do so within 30 days of the completion of the applicable Project Backing Period by contacting our Customer Service Center at CustomerService@SuzyToronto.com

Returns and Refunds
If your product arrives damaged due to transit, you may request a return within 30 days of delivery for a replacement or a refund by contacting us at CustomerService@SuzyToronto.com to obtain a Return Merchandise Authorization number and instructions. We cannot accept for return or replacement any item that has been opened, unless it arrived damaged. If a refund is issued, the purchase price of the item plus applicable sales tax will be credited. You will be responsible to pay the return shipping costs. All eligible refunds are made to the original form of payment. If your product arrives damaged due to transit or fails to comply in all material respects with the specifications for the product, please contact Consumer Care. If Suzy Toronto offices are currently closed, but we invite you to send us an email at CustomerService@SuzyToronto.com.

Processing Your Return
Please allow 21 days to process your return. You will receive notification via e-mail that your return has been received and processed. If, after 21 days, you still have not received an e-mail that your return has been processed, please contact our Customer Service Center at CustomerService@SuzyToronto.com. Please allow up to two billing cycles for any eligible refund to appear on your statement.

Requesting a Return Merchandise Authorization
If you do need to return an item to us and the item is eligible for return, please call us at CustomerService@SuzyToronto.com to obtain a return merchandise authorization number and instructions. Please note that we cannot accept any returns without a Return Merchandise Authorization. All unauthorized returns will be returned to sender.


Packing and Sending Your Return

  1. Once you have received your Return Merchandise Authorization, pack the items securely in a box. You can use the box that the items arrived in or another box, if you prefer. Please ensure all old shipping labels and barcodes have been removed.
  2. Write the Return Merchandise Authorization number on the outside of the box, along with the address provided in the instructions.
  3. Send your Return to us using an insured or trackable shipping that is most convenient for you

Ok, So... This is me!

I love my life.  It’s a wild, wacky, wonderful roller coaster of a ride full of fun and laughter.  And, like yours, it’s also jammed with jolting ups and downs, sharp turns, and inside-out loops that make my head spin. But you know what makes my heart tingle and keeps me living a life worth loving?  Humor.  And, believe me, I see it everywhere, whether it’s reminding myself that “Life Is All About How You Handle Plan B” or acknowledging that “Real Living Begins Where Your Comfort Zone Ends.”  I can justify a certain addiction by telling myself that “Behind Every Successful Woman Is a Substantial Amount of Chocolate,” and I absolutely “Never Underestimate the Power of a Hissie Fit.”  My bottom line is “Pretending to Be a Normal Person Day After Day Is Exhausting.”  Wouldn’t you agree? 

I guess when it comes down to it my philosophy is that life should be good, whatever it takes. My hope is that my stories and illustrations make you laugh, encourage you to take yourself less seriously, and give you the ability to see that, in spite of any hairpin turns on your particular roller coaster, you truly are living a life worth loving.

So sure, I’m a tad wacky and just shy of crazy.  But I’m 67 years old, I dance the hula  and live in a funky little town called New Smyrna Beach right on the oceans edge and my studio is right across the street. I eat way too much chocolate, (I like the dark stuff), I ride a little red scooter around town and I dance the Hula twice a week with a bunch of the most Wonderful Wacky Women God ever created.  I am blessed to be married to the love of my life, “Big Al,” for 39 years. We have five grown children and 16 grandkids and 1 great grand who love me as much as I adore them. No, my life is not perfect but this I believe with all my heart: Life doesn’t need to be perfect to be wonderful. This is the Wild Wacky Wonderful life I lead, and I wouldn’t have it any other way.

In 2022 I started traveling the world. Exploring Europe a full month at a time to soak it all in. Still going to my beloved islands of Hawai’i as often as I can. This year 2025 I’m off to Croatia, Montenegro, and Malta. Checking out Istanbul while we’re in the region. While taking up new art forms of wood burning, and painting the woods with various stains and pigments. At the end of 2024 I spent 3 months giving holiday tours at the 1886 historic Stetson Mansion. Al tags along trying to keep up!

I have been blessed throughout my life to be surrounded by the most amazing women…my mother, my daughters, my sister and my friends.As close as l am to all of them, there is one who is set apart from the rest… my best friend, Launi. I call her my “bestie” but in reality we are so much more…we are kindred spirit. There have been times in both of our lives when we’ve clung to each other as if our lives depended on it, and come to find out… they did. Together we have weathered some of life’s greatest storms. When I count my blessings, I really do count her twice. The only woman I’ve ever met who’s life is more upside-down and inside-out than my own, she is, without a doubt, the wackiest woman I know.

Here is my husband Al, enjoying the afternoon at the Sandy Mountain Art Festival in Oregon. I am fortunate to have a man in my life who “gets-it!” He is a fabulous support for me and my art. I often tease him at shows and call him my “Beast of Burden.” But the truth is, without him, both physically and emotionally, I wouldn’t be able to survive in this business. He’s an amazing guy! Today he runs the financial/legal end of our growing studio. Thank goodness he has a left brain that can figure that all out ’cause heaven knows, I do not have one!!!!

I’m often asked about our youngest son… the wacky kid who started it all. The youngest of our five children. Chase is now 42 years old, a computer genius and flies airplanes for a hobby.

He’s married with a baby on the way and living a life worth loving at the base of the Wasatch Mountain in Salt lake City Utah.. Viewing the world from his own wacky perspective, Chase helps out with the business computers and joins us occasionally at shows. To this day we all still tease him about his innocent question that started the Wonderful Wacky Women line. “Mommy, who is she that grew me In her tummy?”

He was the wackiest little kid who has grown into the most amazing man…and he still makes us all laugh. I smile whenever I think about him.

   This is Robert Thimm. I just call him Rob.  He has been the Art Director at my Studio for two decades! But that title doesn’t begin to describe who Rob is to me. He is literally the sticky, glitter, glue stick that hold our studio together. He is the right brain to my wacky left brain and keeps everything working and flowing like a real business instead of the tornado that swirls in multiple direction whenever I get a wacky creative idea. He is the calm in the wild, “hurricane in a teacup” that is my world. And he is one of the very best friends I’ve ever had. Both my husband Al and I trust him with it all… my life, my family, my business. Bottom line, without him, Suzy Toronto Studios would not exist. So in addition to being the best Art Director in the history of forever, I’d also add that he is “Sticky Glittery, Gluey, Right Brained, Warm and Fuzzy Human Tranquilizer of a Friend that always has my back. How incredibly blessed am I? 

Any questions, comments, or ideas, just call 407-775-9984

Or you can email me at SuzyToronto@yahoo.com

My Creative Process

More than once I have been asked about the creative process I use to create my Wonderful Wacky Women. As the daughter of an artist who is the daughter of an artist, I take it for granted that most of the process comes without fore thought or planning. But everything has a beginning. Since a lot of you are artist or crafty with all sorts of mediums, I thought I’d share my process with you.
It all starts with an inspiration from family and friends who plant the seeds of my creation. Once the idea is in my wacky head, I start with a watercolor paper by Strathmore called Aquarius. I lightly sketch out my characters shape, careful not to press too hard as the paper is horrendously unforgiving. Then dive right in with either a black fine tip Sharpie marker or a Micron Pen. Once inked in, I paint it with a variety of  watercolors sticking only with the transparent ones that include a lot of a brand called Holbien. I really love their paint yet I really can’t pinpoint why. Just great quality, pigment rich color.  (I’m addicted to a color called “Opera Pink”)
 
I make lots of mistakes and start over three or four times… Yes, this is part of the process. Because sometimes it takes seeing what I don’t want to realize exactly what I do want!
I allow my creation to dry a good 24 hours before I then digitally scan my piece and import it into Photoshop. It is there I add the words to the stories I write and the whole piece takes on a life of its own.
As Paul Harvey says, “And now you know the rest of the story!”
